mapper.sql: select a.id as acceptance_id, a.code as acceptance_code, a.accept_date, a.total_amount as acceptance_total_amount, do.code as delivery_code, do.delivery_date, a.customer_id, coalesce(customer.alias, customer.name) as customer_name, a.delivery_point_id, cd.name as delivery_point_name, ai.product_name, ai.product_spec, ai.product_unit, ai.actual_quantity, ai.difference_quantity, ai.unit_price, ai.actual_amount, ai.sort from acceptance a inner join acceptance_item ai on ai.acceptance_id = a.id inner join t_delivery_order do on do.id = a.delivery_order_id left join t_customer customer on customer.id = a.customer_id left join t_customer_dept cd on cd.id = a.delivery_point_id
mapper.select: select case when s.id is not null then 1 else 0 end as settled, sum(a.total_amount) as amount from acceptance a left join t_month_settlement s on s.customer_id = a.customer_id and s.bill_month = date_format(a.accept_date, '%Y-%m') and s.status = 1 where a.status = 1 and a.is_deleted = 0 and a.accept_date between #{beginDate} and #{endDate} group by settled
select coalesce(sum(total_amount), 0) from purchase_order where is_deleted = 0 and status != 3 and order_date between #{beginDate} and #{endDate}
select coalesce(sum(total_amount), 0) from purchase_order where is_deleted = 0 and status in (0, 1) and order_date between #{beginDate} and #{endDate}
